---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something the app should do.
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the situation where the current app falls short. *"I keep trying to do X, and I end up doing Y because the app doesn't support Z."*

## What do you wish the app did?

One or two sentences describing the feature or change.

## Who else would benefit?

- [ ] Technical users only
- [ ] Non-technical users
- [ ] Both

Features that help non-technical users (smoother setup, clearer errors, less fiddling with config files) are higher priority than features that add raw capability.

## Alternatives you've considered

What workarounds are you using today? What other tools do this well? Anything I should look at before implementing?

## Anything else?

Screenshots, sketches, links to similar features elsewhere, anything.
